eSway ERP 2.0

Smart Software.
Seamless Logistics.

Powered by eSway.ai

Intelligent logistics management built for modern businesses. Streamline operations, automate workflows, and move smarter with AI-powered solutions.

One ERP. The whole freight chain.

Freight ForwardingSea and air, import and export
Customs ClearanceFiling, duty and clearance
TransportTrips, LR and delivery proof
WarehouseInward, storage and dispatch

Freight Forwarding

  • Lead, enquiry, quotation, booking and job in one flow
  • FCL / LCL, sea and air, import and export
  • House BL, MTD and HAWB with print and PDF
  • Charges, invoices, debit notes and vendor bills
  • Airline, sea line, IATA and CFS masters

Customs Clearance

  • Bill of Entry and Shipping Bill filing
  • Assessment, duty and examination tracking
  • Out of Charge and delivery order
  • HSN / SAC and tax masters
  • Linked to the job, the invoice and the ledger

Transport

  • Vehicle and driver allocation
  • LR / GR, trips and delivery proof
  • Vendor payables and trip costing
  • Pickup and delivery from the quotation
  • Status visible on the job

Warehouse & CFS

  • Inward, storage and dispatch
  • Stock lines with dates and storage days
  • CFS master linked to the organization
  • Charges flow to the job and the invoice
  • Stage checklist for every shipment

Individual modules. Compact and customised.

  • Each module works on its own or together with the rest
  • Switch on only what your company needs
  • Roles, charges, numbering and documents set up per company
  • One organization record used everywhere, with all its roles
  • Multi-tenant and financial-year aware

API integrations

  • GST e-invoice and e-way bill (through your GSP)
  • ICEGATE customs filing
  • Carrier and airline tracking
  • Email and WhatsApp notifications
  • Bank statements and accounting exports

Integration-ready: each connection is switched on with your own credentials.

Shipment Configuration
FCL — specify container requirement
 LCL shipment — charged by CBM/weight (whichever higher). No container booking required at job creation; consolidation box/CFS will be assigned during operations.
 Air Freight is charged on Chargeable Weight = greater of Gross Weight (KG) and Volumetric Weight (L×W×H ÷ 6,000). No container required — enter Packages / Weight / CBM in the Cargo panel.
Chargeable Weight (CBM × 167 vs KG, higher wins) — KG
 Enter cargo details in the Cargo panel. Mode-specific fields for this transport type will follow the operations checklist during job execution.

📐 Volumetric Weight Formulas (IATA Standard)
cm + kg
(L × W × H) ÷ 6,000
Example: 120×80×50 = 480,000 ÷ 6,000 = 80 kg
inches + lbs
(L × W × H) ÷ 166
Example: 48×40×28 = 53,760 ÷ 166 = 324 lbs
cm → CBM
(L × W × H) × 167
1 CBM of air cargo = 167 kg chargeable

SOPs & Workflow
Standard Operating Procedures — step-by-step guides for all ERP modules
SOP-01 — Organization Master Setup
Create & configure any party: client, carrier, CHA, agent, transporter
1
Navigate → New Organization

Click + New Org in top bar. Org Code must be unique (max 20 chars). Use recognizable abbreviation e.g. TATACHEM.

2
Set Category, Country & Screening

Category: BUS / NAT / GOV. Country determines which registration fields appear. Screening = Not Screened initially.

Never assign an org as a party in any job until Screening = CLR (Cleared).

3
Toggle Role Flags

is_shipper → Shipper Defaults tab. is_receivable → AR/COA tab → COA 1100. is_payable → AP/COA tab → COA 2100. Each flag opens its dedicated sub-screen and sub-table.

4
Registration & COA Setup

Add GST, PAN, TAN, IEC in Registration tab. Set coa_ar_id = 1101 for customers, coa_ap_id = 2101 for vendors. Set credit limit, credit days, payment terms.

GSTIN mandatory before raising any AR invoice for Indian customers.

5
Save & Verify

Click Save → system validates GSTIN checksum format and creates the sub-ledger account automatically. Org now appears in all Shipper/Consignee/Carrier/CHA dropdowns across the ERP.

SOP-02 — Sea Export FCL/LCL Processing
End-to-end from inquiry to closure — booking, BL, customs, billing
1
Quotation → Job Creation

Sales team sends quote. On acceptance → Jobs → New Job. Type = Forwarding, Mode = Sea, Direction = Export, Dept = SEX. System generates Job No: IN-RGC-MAA-SEX-25-XXXXXX.

2
Booking Confirmation

Bookings tab → enter carrier booking no, vessel/voyage, ETD. Set SI cutoff, VGM cutoff, cargo cutoff.

SI must be submitted at least 3 working days before ETD cutoff.

3
Customs, Loading & BL

CHA files Shipping Bill on ICEGATE. LEO received → update in Customs tab. Gate-In → Loaded → Tracking updated. BL issued → review Draft → confirm Original/Surrender/Telex.

Original BL released only after full payment confirmed by Accounts.

4
Invoice & Job Closure

Charges tab → verify all AR lines → Create Invoice → Approve → COA auto-posts DR 1101 / CR 3100. All AP bills approved, all AR paid → P&L FINAL → job_status = CLOSED.

SOP-03 — Invoice & Payment (AR)
Creating, approving, GST e-Invoice, and COA reconciliation
1
Create Invoice

Job Charges tab → verify AR lines → "Create Invoice" → system copies AR lines. Auto-assigns invoice no from number range.

2
GST & e-Invoice

Each line: correct SAC code + GST rate. Intra-state = CGST+SGST. Inter-state / Export = IGST.

Invoices above ₹5 Lakh require GST e-Invoice IRN via GSTN before sending to customer.

3
Approve → COA Post → Collect Payment

Approve → DR 1101 / CR 3100 auto-posted. Send email with PDF. Finance → Payments → New Receipt → allocate to invoice.

Never close a job until all AR invoices show payment_status = PAID.

SOP-04 — CHA / Customs Clearance (Import)
Bill of Entry, duty payment, examination, OOC, delivery order
1
Receive Documents & File BE

Collect BL, CI, PKL from shipper/agent. Upload to Documents tab. CHA files Bill of Entry on ICEGATE. Update BE No, BE Date in Customs tab.

BE must be filed within 30 days of IGM date to avoid late filing penalties.

2
Duty Payment & OOC

Update assessable value, duty amounts. Get importer approval → pay duty: DR 4300 / CR Bank 1202. If examination triggered → schedule examiner. On clearance → OOC date updated → collect DO from shipping line.

3
Delivery & Closure

Arrange transport for final delivery → update Transport module with LR/POD. Once POD confirmed and CHA service fee invoiced → close job.

SOP-05 — Road Transport & ePOD
Vehicle allocation, LR generation, delivery confirmation
1
Create Transport Job & Allocate Vehicle

Transport module → New Transport Job. Enter pickup/delivery points, select vehicle from fleet master, generate LR number RGC-LR-25-XXXX.

2
Track & Deliver

Update pickup date on dispatch. Driver app or manual entry updates delivery date and captures ePOD (signature/photo).

Invoice cannot be raised until ePOD is uploaded and verified.

3
Bill & Close

Charges tab → add TRANS charge code → Create Invoice. Vendor bill from transporter recorded in AP → job P&L locked once both sides settled.
